spans.s:
Bhrānta : nt.: One of the twenty-one movements (mārga) used by a swordsman.

Dhṛṣṭadyumna used it when he, with a sword and a shield in hand, wanted to attack Drona who was shooting arrows at him 7. 164. 145-148.
